limit.description: Limit and Offset echo the page that was asked for. A page with fewer than Limit items is the last.

reason.description: Reason is why the campaign is cancelled; it is recorded and sent to Notification. At most 1000 characters. Without one, "cancelled by the marketer" is used.

body.description: Body is the note the marketer adds to the open step. At most 2000 characters.

brief.description: Brief is what the marketer wants, in their own words. At most 2000 characters.
brief.example: Son 30 günde sepetine ürün ekleyip alışveriş yapmayan İstanbul'daki kullanıcılara %30 indirim hatırlatması gönder. Samimi ama kısa olsun.

at.description: At is the time the ping was sent.

code.description: Code is the stable machine-readable name of the problem.

detail.description: Detail explains this occurrence. It never contains internal details.
detail.example: The step is approved; reopen it to change it.

instance.description: Instance is the path of the request.

problems.description: Problems lists the individual validation messages of an invalid request or invalid content.

status.description: Status is the HTTP status code.

title.description: Title is a short, fixed summary of the problem type.

type.description: Type identifies the problem type: urn:coldbru:proposal:problem:<code>.

reason.description: Reason tells the model what was wrong; it is used when the slot is regenerated. At most 1000 characters.

kind.description: Kind is the approved step to revise; it and every later step are replaced.

cost.description: Cost is the estimated cost of the live content variants (D-071).

notes.description: Notes are all context notes, oldest first.

steps.description: Steps are the current steps, in step order: everything that is not superseded.

timezone.description:
Timezone is the IANA time zone of a schedule slot, for example Europe/Istanbul; empty for
every other step.

failed.description:
Failed: the last generation of the step failed (a refusal, an exhausted repair loop, an
API error), and Reason says why. Regenerate retries it.

generating.description: Generating: a generation of this step is queued or running in this process.

missing.description: Missing are the slots of an open step that have no draft or approved variant yet.

variants.description: Variants are the draft, approved and rejected variants, oldest first.

detail.description:
Detail is what the check found out besides pass or fail, for example "mode=mock"; empty for
checks that report none.

error.description: Error is the failure reason; empty when the check passed.

checks.description: Checks maps dependency name to its result; omitted when no check is registered.

status.description: Status is "ok" when every check passed, otherwise "fail".

info.description: REST API of the proposal service: campaigns, their proposal steps and variants, and the live event stream of a campaign. There is no authentication in the demo (D-072). Errors are RFC 9457 application/problem+json.
info.title: Coldbru Proposal API

get.description: Returns one page of campaigns, newest first.

422.description: limit or offset out of range

post.description: Stores the brief as a new campaign and returns at once (202). The brief is screened and the audience proposed in the background; follow the progress with GET /campaigns/{id}/events. A blocked brief cancels the campaign.

422.description: Empty or too long brief, unknown field

get.description: Returns the campaign with its current steps and their live variants, the context notes and the estimated cost.

post.description: Cancels a campaign that is a draft, scheduled or sending. A draft only changes status; a scheduled or sending campaign also queues the cancelled event so that Notification stops sending. The body, and the reason in it, are optional. Returns the updated campaign.

400.description: id is not a UUID, or malformed JSON

409.description: campaign_not_cancellable: the campaign is completed or already cancelled

post.description: Retries the confirmation of a campaign whose schedule step is approved but which is still a draft, for example after the automatic confirmation failed (a Customer outage). It fetches the recipients, assigns each person their channel(s) under the approved plan and, in one transaction, sets the campaign to `scheduled` and queues the confirmed event and the recipient batches for NATS. Returns the updated campaign.

409.description: campaign_not_drafting: already scheduled, cancelled or sent; schedule_not_approved; no_recipients: the plan reaches nobody now

502.description: confirm_failed: Customer or the database failed; nothing changed, try again

post.description: Records a note on the open step. Its draft and rejected variants are replaced and regenerated with the note (202); approved variants stay.

400.description: id is not a UUID, or malformed JSON

409.description: The campaign is not a draft, or has no open step

post.summary: Add context to the open step

get.description:
Opens a text/event-stream. The first event is `snapshot`: the whole campaign view, the same JSON as GET /campaigns/{id}. After it come the events of the flow, each as `event: <name>` and `data: <JSON>`, in the order they happened; the data of every event is documented as a property of api.EventCatalog. A `ping` event is sent every 15 seconds.

The server subscribes before it takes the snapshot, so no event between the two is missed; an event that happened just before the snapshot may arrive again after it, so apply events idempotently (by variant id, step id and note id). There is no replay: a client that reconnects gets a new snapshot. When the server notices that it could not keep up with the events of a slow client it sends a fresh `snapshot` and carries on; always replace your state with a snapshot.

Events of the content step: `content_delta` carries a fragment of the text being written and its `attempt`; `content_reset` announces that attempt 2 or 3 starts because the previous answer broke a rule, and the preview of that slot must be cleared. The variant is final only with `variant_created`.

Lifecycle events: `campaign_confirmed` (the schedule was confirmed and the campaign is `scheduled`; carries the recipient counts per channel and the number of recipient batches) and `campaign_cancelled` (the campaign was cancelled by a screening block or by the marketer).

The response is not JSON; the schema below only documents the data of each event.

200.description: Stream of events; each event's data is the property of the same name

404.description: No such campaign (answered before the stream starts)

get.summary: Live events of a campaign (Server-Sent Events)

post.description: Restarts the screening and the audience proposal of a campaign whose process stopped before the audience step opened (202). Does nothing while the pipeline is running.

409.description: The campaign is not a draft, or already has steps

post.summary: Restart a campaign that has no steps

post.description: Revises an approved step: it and every later step are replaced, a new version of the step opens and its generation starts (202).

400.description: id is not a UUID, or malformed JSON

404.description: No such campaign, or it has no step of that kind

409.description: The campaign is not a draft, or the step is not approved

get.description: Answers 200 while the process is running. Checks no dependency.
Runs every dependency check (for example postgres, nats) and answers 200 when all pass, 503 otherwise.

post.description: Retries the generation of an open step, after a failure or a restart (202). Slots that have a draft or approved variant are left alone. Returns the campaign.

409.description: The step is not open, or the campaign is not a draft

post.description: Approves a draft variant. When it was the last slot of its step the step is approved and the next one opens and starts generating; approving the schedule step confirms the campaign. Returns the updated campaign.

409.description: The campaign is not a draft, the step is not open, or the variant is not a draft

502.description: The schedule was approved but confirming the campaign failed; the approval stands

post.description: Replaces a draft variant with the edited content, which passes the validators generated content passes. The edit becomes a new draft variant in the same slot and the old one is replaced. Invalid content is a 422 whose problems list every broken rule.

400.description: id is not a UUID, or malformed JSON

409.description: The step is not open, or the variant is not a draft

422.description: The content failed validation; problems lists why

post.description: Rejects a draft variant with a reason. Only its slot is regenerated, with the reason given to the model (202). Returns the updated campaign.

400.description: id is not a UUID, or malformed JSON

409.description: The campaign is not a draft, the step is not open, or the variant is not a draft
